# Issue templates

Templates in this directory enforce eval-first work packets. They collect requirement refs, subject/owner, parentage, path leases, preconditions/actions/observables, negative controls, artifacts, exit/state semantics, cleanup/residue, exclusions, rollback, and merge order before implementation.

Do not add a template that allows a task to begin without an owner, parent branch, allowed paths, rollback subject, and at least one negative control.
